senses.zh_definition: 人名 Tyreese；可指《行尸走肉》中的同名角色，具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A personal name; also the name of a character in The Walking Dead.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang; juga nama watak dalam siri The Walking Dead.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，无可直接翻译的马来语普通词义。AMC 确认 Chad L. Coleman 饰演名为 Tyreese 的角色，但不能据此认定输入中的每次出现都指该角色。[AMC 角色访谈](https://www.amc.com/blogs/the-walking-dead-qa-chad-l-coleman-tyreese--1008746)
senses.collocation_note: 以上为自然的专名组合，不宣称具有经语料库验证的高频地位。

etymology.historical_story: Tyreese is documented as a character name in AMC’s The Walking Dead, with Chad L. Coleman playing the role. This establishes a cultural use, rather than the name’s original derivation. Names appearing in Malay entertainment discussion can enter word lists without becoming Malay vocabulary. No reliable historical derivation is established by the supplied packet. [AMC interview](https://www.amc.com/blogs/the-walking-dead-qa-chad-l-coleman-tyreese--1008746)
